themes_detail.label: Homeless encampments and street outreach surge
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints have spiked 1100% this past 2 weeks (3 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), while homeless person assistance requests jumped 300% THIS WEEK (3 complaints vs. 0.8 weekly average), signaling either a sudden population increase or deteriorating conditions; this aligns with the Community Board's repeated annual budget request to expand street outreach and upgrade homeless facilities.
evidence: Encampment complaints: 3 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (z-score 4.16, +1100%)
Homeless person assistance: 3 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly baseline (z-score 2.71, +300%)
Community Board budget request (recurring, year over year): Expand street outreach and upgrade homeless facilities
reporting_angles: Ground reporting: Where are encampments forming and why now? Interview DHS street outreach teams and affected residents.
Policy angle: Why has the Community Board requested expanded outreach funding for multiple years without visible results? Track DHS budget allocation and service delivery.

themes_detail.label: Street and sidewalk noise spike
themes_detail.summary: Street/sidewalk noise complaints surged 233% LAST WEEK (60 complaints vs. 18.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks, z-score 3.04), while vehicle noise complaints doubled (12 vs. 6.0 weekly average), even as residential noise fell 48% THIS WEEK—suggesting a shift in noise source or timing that warrants investigation.
evidence: Street/sidewalk noise: 60 complaints last week vs. 18.0 weekly baseline (z-score 3.04, +233%)
Vehicle noise: 12 complaints last week vs. 6.0 weekly baseline (z-score 3.0, +100%)
Residential noise: 105 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 202.1 weekly baseline (-48%, inverse spike)
reporting_angles: Service calls analysis: What specific locations are generating street noise complaints? Are construction, street fairs, or transit work scheduled?
Quality of life: Interview residents in high-complaint areas about what they're hearing and when.

themes_detail.label: Dead animal complaints spike
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints jumped 336% three weeks ago (6 complaints vs. 1.4 weekly average, z-score 4.16), a statistically severe outlier; while this occurred 3 weeks ago rather than this week, the high z-score and potential public health angle warrant verification of whether the issue is ongoing or resolved.
evidence: Dead animal complaints: 6 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 1.4 weekly baseline (z-score 4.16, +336%)
Spike is 3 weeks old; current status unclear from available data
reporting_angles: Public health check: Did the spike reflect a disease outbreak, rodent infestation, or isolated incident? Contact DOHMH and Sanitation.
Follow-up verification: Query 311 to see if dead animal complaints have normalized or persisted.

themes_detail.label: Obstruction complaints elevated
themes_detail.summary: Obstruction complaints more than doubled 2 weeks ago (7 complaints vs. 3.0 weekly average, z-score 3.02, +133%), indicating a possible sidewalk or street blockage pattern (likely linked to the concurrent encampment spike or illegal parking/driveway blocking issues).
evidence: Obstruction complaints: 7 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 3.0 weekly baseline (z-score 3.02, +133%)
Temporal alignment with encampment spike (3 complaints 2 weeks ago) and high illegal parking baseline (2,183 complaints over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Pattern analysis: Are obstructions clustered in specific blocks or linked to encampments, parked vehicles, or construction?
Street access equity: Interview residents about mobility barriers and Sanitation enforcement response times.
